moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! is ON!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! kicked off on Monday, November 16th, with Ant and Dec hosting a new lineup of stars in the Australian jungle, including Wayne Rooney, Joanna Page, and Ade Adepitan.

angles.name: Who's your pick?
angles.copy: It's been a wild few days in the jungle already! Who's your early favourite to be crowned King or Queen? #ImACeleb

angles.name: Bushtucker Trials
angles.copy: Another night, another Bushtucker Trial! What's the worst challenge you've seen so far this series? The critters are out in force!

angles.name: Rooney in the Jungle
angles.copy: From the Premier League pitch to the jungle camp, Wayne Rooney is taking on the Bushtucker Trials! How do you think he's doing?

moments.title: Black Friday is next week!
moments.blurb: Black Friday 2026 officially takes place on Friday, November 27th, with many retailers already starting their sales ahead of the big day, followed by Cyber Monday on November 30th.

angles.name: Shopping prep
angles.copy: Black Friday is just around the corner! Are you planning to grab any deals, or are you steering clear of the shopping frenzy?

angles.name: Best deals?
angles.copy: Early Black Friday deals are already starting to pop up! What are you hoping to find a discount on this year?

angles.name: Cyber Monday
angles.copy: Don't forget, after Black Friday comes Cyber Monday on November 30th for all those online bargains! What's on your tech wishlist?

moments.title: Cardiff Christmas Market is open!
moments.blurb: The popular Cardiff Christmas Market is in full swing, running from November 12th to December 23rd, 2026, across the city centre with dozens of festive stalls.

angles.name: Market magic
angles.copy: Cardiff's city centre is twinkling! The Christmas Market is open and packed with unique gifts and festive food. What's your favourite stall?

angles.name: Winter Wonderland
angles.copy: Beyond the market, Cardiff Winter Wonderland with its ice rink and big wheel is also open until January 3rd! Perfect for a festive day out.

angles.name: Local crafts
angles.copy: Supporting local at the Cardiff Christmas Market! So many incredible Welsh crafts, food, and gifts on offer. Have you visited yet?

moments.title: Exeter Christmas Market now open
moments.blurb: The Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market is delighting visitors on Cathedral Green, running from November 13th to December 13th, 2026, with over a hundred chalets.

angles.name: Festive Exeter
angles.copy: Exeter Cathedral Green is transformed! The Christmas Market is open and buzzing with festive cheer, food, and unique gifts. What's caught your eye?

angles.name: Local traders
angles.copy: Supporting Devon's finest! The Exeter Christmas Market features handpicked traders showcasing the best of the West Country. Find something special!

angles.name: Evening visits
angles.copy: The Exeter Christmas Market is open late, until 9pm, from Thursday to Saturday! Perfect for a magical evening browse under the Cathedral spires.

moments.title: Wales face Australia in Autumn International
moments.blurb: Wales will take on Australia in a highly anticipated Autumn Nations Championship fixture this Saturday, November 21st, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, with an 8:10 PM kick-off.

angles.name: Big game build-up
angles.copy: It's a massive weekend for Welsh rugby! Wales take on Australia on Saturday night. Are you ready for the big game? #WALvAUS

angles.name: Principality atmosphere
angles.copy: The Principality Stadium will be rocking on Saturday! Who are you watching the Wales vs Australia match with?

angles.name: Match prediction
angles.copy: Four changes for Wales ahead of their clash with Australia! What's your score prediction for Saturday's Autumn International?

moments.title: New Official Singles Chart out tomorrow
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart is updated every Friday, and tomorrow, November 20th, will see a new chart reveal the biggest songs across the UK.

angles.name: Chart anticipation
angles.copy: New music Friday means a new Official Singles Chart tomorrow! What song do you think will be crowned number one?

angles.name: Who's climbing?
angles.copy: Any predictions for big climbers or new entries in tomorrow's UK Singles Chart? Let us know what you're hoping to see!

angles.name: Your top pick
angles.copy: If you could pick ANY song to be tomorrow's UK number one, what would it be and why?

moments.title: Happy 79th Birthday, Joe Walsh!
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist Joe Walsh, known for his work with the Eagles, James Gang, and his solo career, celebrates his 79th birthday tomorrow, November 20th.

angles.name: Eagles legend
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we're celebrating the one and only Joe Walsh turning 79! What's your all-time favourite Eagles track featuring his iconic guitar work?

angles.name: Solo hits
angles.copy: Beyond the Eagles, Joe Walsh has a fantastic solo career! Which of his hits like 'Life's Been Good' gets you singing along?

angles.name: Guitar hero
angles.copy: Happy almost-birthday to guitar hero Joe Walsh! His riffs are legendary. What's his most unforgettable guitar solo for you?

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Björk!
moments.blurb: The innovative Icelandic singer, songwriter, and producer Björk, celebrated for her unique style and experimental music, turns 61 on Saturday, November 21st.

angles.name: Music innovator
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the incredible Björk on Saturday! Her music always pushes boundaries. What's your favourite Björk album?

angles.name: Iconic tracks
angles.copy: From 'Hyperballad' to 'Army of Me', Björk's discography is iconic. Which of her tracks is always on your playlist?

angles.name: Unique style
angles.copy: Björk's influence on music and fashion is undeniable. What do you love most about her distinctive artistry?

moments.title: Happy 34th Birthday, Miley Cyrus!
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Miley Cyrus, known for her powerful vocals and evolving artistry, will celebrate her 34th birthday on Monday, November 23rd.

angles.name: Pop sensation
angles.copy: Monday marks Miley Cyrus's 34th birthday! From Hannah Montana to 'Flowers', she's been a pop force. What's your favourite Miley era?

angles.name: Power anthems
angles.copy: Miley has given us some incredible anthems! Which of her songs empowers you the most?

angles.name: Evolution of an artist
angles.copy: Through every reinvention, Miley Cyrus remains captivating. What do you admire most about her journey as an artist?

moments.title: Happy 66th Birthday, Amy Grant!
moments.blurb: Award-winning singer-songwriter Amy Grant, known for her crossover success in contemporary Christian and pop music, turns 66 on Wednesday, November 25th.

angles.name: Queen of Christian Pop
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to the wonderful Amy Grant on Wednesday! Her voice is timeless. What's your favourite Amy Grant song?

angles.name: Crossover success
angles.copy: From 'Baby Baby' to her classic Christian hits, Amy Grant has truly spanned genres. What's your go-to track from her incredible career?

angles.name: Inspiring music
angles.copy: Amy Grant's music has touched so many hearts. Share a memory or a lyric from her songs that means a lot to you.

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Randy Newman!
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter and film composer Randy Newman, known for his distinctive voice and satirical songs, celebrates his 83rd birthday on Saturday, November 28th.

angles.name: Musical genius
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the brilliant Randy Newman this Saturday! A true songwriting genius. What's your favourite Randy Newman track?

angles.name: Film score master
angles.copy: From 'Toy Story' to 'Ragtime', Randy Newman's film scores are iconic. Which movie soundtrack of his do you love the most?

angles.name: Satirical wit
angles.copy: Randy Newman's songs are often witty and satirical, like 'Short People' and 'I Love L.A.'. What's your favourite lyric of his?
